pr_title: Fix editor inspector refresh not working
pr_body:
Closes #41675

Inspector will cache refresh interval value so it does not need to `EDITOR_GET` after every interval.
pr_comments: This needs to be reverted, as it misunderstood what refresh is for. Its causing the editor to redraw all the time and this is extremely inefficient.
The correct solution is a smart refresh, checking if properties changed and only then update them, but this is a much bigger undertaking
Removing cherry-pick label as this was reverted.

issue_context.title: Editor Inspector does not auto-refresh
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
4.0 64e0a1290

**OS/device including version:**
WIN 10

**Issue description:**
Editor Inspector does not auto refresh.

**Steps to reproduce:**
The below script, also found in MRP zip is a tool script that auto increments and exported variable. As you can see in the console `prints`, the count is incrementing but the inspector does not show it.

```gdscript
@tool
extends Node2D

@export
var count = 0

var accum: float = 0;
func _process(delta):
	accum += delta

	if accum > 1:
		count += 1
		print("Upped counter to %s" % count)
		accum = 0
```

**Minimal reproduction project:**
[EditorInspRefresh.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/5156394/EditorInspRefresh.zip)

I already have fixed this quickly as I needed it for a PR I am working on but will look at it again and submit a proper PR. The issue is that the timer counter for the refresh in `EditorInspector` never actually starts...

review_comments: That means that a restart is needed to take changes into account. Is the setting defined with `EDITOR_DEF_RST`?

No, it's just set with `_initial_set("docks/property_editor/auto_refresh_interval", 0.3);` in `editor_settings.cpp`. But I don't follow what you mean here..

> That means that a restart is needed to take changes into account.

What means it needs a restart?

In my testing, I changed the refresh interval value in the editor settings window to 5 seconds and it was immediately applied, and the value in my test scene (see linked issue) was only refreshing every 5 seconds. I then changed it back to 0.3 and the value started refreshing every 0.3 seconds, as expected.
Well this is set in `NOTIFICATION_READY`, so it would run only once normally. Or is the EditorInspector recreated when settings change?
It gets set both in `NOTIFICATION_READY` and `NOTIFICATION_EDITOR_SETTINGS_CHANGED`. I  the latter is not called on opening of the engine, so I put it in ready too.
Ah indeed, I missed it while reviewing on phone. All good then.
